The exact source-ordered list is [H_W^(kappa),U_indic,O_DT^S,Ry_boundary,O_DT^BS,U_indic^dagger,O_f,SWAP(two n-qubit registers; paper label only),(O_D^BS)^dagger,(H_W^(kappa))^dagger]. The list definition and length theorem fix these identities/order and length10 only. Every item is Gate.oracleCall with a string, not an interpreted matrix/primitive program. A dagger-looking label does not establish inverse semantics; the transcript alone proves neither unitarity, cleanup, a projected target block nor an oracle resource implementation.

The SWAP label is especially explicit: naming a swap between two registers does not execute its wire action here. A separate SourceBaseline module supplies a three-pair logical swap fragment [(0,3),(1,4),(2,5)] and associated definitions, but that separate object is not imported as matrix correctness of this string transcript by its name. Replacing the label with a physical circuit, composing its matrices and proving the full ten-block action require separate bridges; one must not infer them from the transcript's list equality.

The visible partition sums to5+1+3+0+3+1=13. Removing the3 system wires leaves10 non-system backend wires for the clean projection. The layout's declared signal count is9=5+1+3, and effective10=declared9+paddedOD0+trailing1. This matches the source's complete effective-signal layout bridge. It is dimension/bookkeeping arithmetic, not a proof that the non-system outputs are clean after execution or that their projection encodes the desired block.

Visible pure ancillas in this partition are paddedOD0+trailing1=1. The theorem-level layout/resource field is2n=6 at n3. Source documentation explicitly says that full pure-ancilla budget also includes internal sparse-access/oracle workspace, unlike the narrower visible ket partition. Thus the three facts 'visible13', 'declared signal9/effective10' and 'theorem pure budget6' refer to different scopes. The historical phrase 'total13 physical qubits' is unsupported if meant to include all internal implementation workspace; the exact theorem establishes the visible backend total, not that expanded physical upper bound. This is a scope obstruction, not a proof that an optimized physical implementation necessarily needs more than13 wires.

No exact fully expanded footprint follows from these fields alone. One cannot simply add system3+signal9+pure6 as disjoint simultaneously live registers, nor declare6-1=5 additional physical wires or add that to13 without overlap/lifetime/subcircuit allocation evidence. A budget is not a tight minimality theorem. Uninterpreted oracle labels can stand for implementations with different workspace; even padding a hidden implementation would leave this list unchanged. Cleanup and reuse would need actual semantic proofs, and a zero visible padded register does not make internal oracle work free. Conversely the arithmetic bridge does not assert a success probability, normalizer, finite-bit gate cost or circuit-resource certification. The initial assumption that SWAP semantics live elsewhere remains intact, but those semantics and the whole source-paper resource theorem are not freshly verified here.
